findings.summary: F paste layer: 255 flashes vs 679 copper (38%)
findings.description: F-side paste layer has significantly fewer flashes (255) than copper layer (679). This may indicate missing solder paste apertures.
findings.recommendation: Check solder paste aperture generation — missing apertures cause assembly defects.
